isolation: Every rooms-api endpoint the app depends on (GET /rooms, GET /me/bookings, POST /me/bookings, DELETE /me/bookings/{id}) returned a gateway-level 404 for every attempt in this run, both through the webapp's UI and when called directly against the endpoint named for rooms-api in the validation dispatch, with and without a valid test-member bearer token. No scenario's Given could create or confirm room/booking state through any interface, so none of this run's assertions depend on data another concurrent run could have mutated: there was no live rooms-api to mutate anything on. The one scenario that did not need rooms-api (the signed-out redirect) was driven in its own fresh, never-authenticated browser session so it could not inherit the signed-in state built up while investigating the other scenarios.
